title: T1 Card
description: A user-facing capsule (system_artifact_types.md): title, key innovation, definition formula, high-level evaluation. Displayed directly in the UI (per method, per paper, per finding). NEVER delivered into any member's brief. Structured-lite: short required fields, free text inside. Total serialized size must stay under 2048 bytes (runtime-enforced hard cap).

subject_ref.description: What this card describes: a method stable_id, a literature source id, or a record family+generation.

title.description: The display title. For methods this IS the T0 title (proposer-authored in P2; lead may revise at P2 reconciliation).

innovation.description: The key innovation in one or two sentences.

definition.description: The definition formula or formulation, as compactly as it can be stated.

evaluation.description: Very high-level evaluation: status, strengths, caveats.
